intro: Потому что introduces a cause; поскольку and так как usually present a more neutral or formal reason.

piezas.titulo: Потому что introduces a cause; поскольку and так как usually present a more neutral or formal reason.
texto: Потому что introduces a cause; поскольку and так как usually present a more neutral or formal reason.
Do not confuse cause with result: поэтому introduces the consequence in the following clause.

frases.estudio: Занятие перенесли, потому что преподаватель заболел.
frases.alumno: The class was postponed because the teacher fell ill.

frases.estudio: Поскольку срок истекал, заявку отправили утром.
frases.alumno: As the deadline was running out, they sent the application in the morning.

pregunta.texto: Which connector expresses a consequence, not a cause?

opciones.explicacion: Поэтому here means «therefore» and presents the result.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Занятие перенесли, потому что преподаватель заболел.»

frase.texto: Занятие перенесли, потому что преподаватель заболел.

opciones.texto: The class was postponed because the teacher fell ill.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: As the deadline was running out, they sent the application in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Поскольку срок истекал, заявку отправили утром

piezas.traduccion: As the deadline was running out, they sent the application in the morning.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
